name: better-rea
description: Runs REA inside an evidence-and-limits loop: a claim ledger a validator checks, a required report format, and a methods reference drawn from reverse-engineering literature. An agent's findings about a compiled app get confirmed or left unknown, not guessed.

interface.shortDescription: Draw REA out to its limit — checked findings, not guesses.
interface.longDescription: Takes REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) and runs it inside an evidence-and-limits loop: every conclusion is a claim with evidence and a limit in a ledger a validator checks, deliverables follow a required report format, and a methods reference distilled from open reverse-engineering literature gives the agent possibilities to confirm or rule out. Findings about a compiled app get confirmed or left unknown, not guessed.
defaultPrompt: Explain this feature well enough to rebuild it.
